name: Palmeral of Elche
description: In the southeastern Spanish city of Elche, tens of thousands of date palms form a green oasis in the middle of a dry landscape. Muslim settlers laid out the groves with an intricate network of irrigation channels in the late 10th century, and date growing here goes back even further, to Iberian times. Today you can wander through palm-shaded gardens, a museum and a park, an unusual piece of Arab farming in Europe.
